college_identity.verified_name: Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology, Surat (SVNIT)
college_identity.identity_notes: One of the original Regional Engineering Colleges, established 1961 as Sardar Vallabhbhai Regional College of Engineering & Technology (SVRCET); granted Deemed University / NIT status on 4 December 2002; declared Institute of National Importance in 2007. Single main campus (~250-265 acres depending on source) on Ichchhanath-Dumas Road, Surat, described across multiple sources as unusually centrally-located within the city compared to many other NITs. Explicitly verified DISTINCT from IIIT Surat — a separate, newer public-private-partnership institute currently operating temporarily from the SVNIT campus while its own facility is under construction, but institutionally independent. Named after Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, India's first Home Minister.

review_items.review_title: SVNIT placements are not much good, but faculty members are good

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'About 60% of the students got placed in 2020 from mechanical engineering. The highest salary package offered was 6.5 LPA, which was provided by L&T. The lowest salary package offered was 3.5 LPA in TCS.'
'Around 20% of students got internships from our course.'
'Facilities are quite good in Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology. Departments are also good. Our college has good Wi-Fi, labs, library and classroom facilities.'

'The average placement rate of SVNIT is more than 70% for top branches. Other branches have comparatively low placements. In the mechanical branch, the placement rate is more than 50%. The top recruiting core companies for mechanical engineering students are L&T, MG Motors.'

'In the mechanical branch, the internship rate is very low. Many have to go for non-core companies and research to get internships. So, students have to go outside and find internships on their own if they want to get placed in core companies.'
'Hostel facilities are good for 3rd and 4th-year students, as they have a separate hostel which is the 2nd best hostel on the campus, after the girls' hostel. The first-year hostel is average.'

'Placements for computer science department is excellent, almost 100% placement. Placements for mechanical engineering is also good, many core companies come for placements every year. Even major companies like HPCL and BPCL come and offer very high packages. Average salary: 5 LPA. Highest salary: 25-30 LPA (computer science), 10-15 LPA (other streams).'
'Students are of all society, it's your way how you get through it, overall no ragging.'
'The institute has good infrastructure. It has a good inside and outside environment; food is available of all type.'
'I had two internships; one in Cadila Ankleshwar and second in GNFC Bharuch. Our college invites various types of companies so not to worry about different field interest.'
